name: ReviewMojo – Reviews & Feedback Funnel
author: jcnovacode

sections.description:
ReviewMojo is a policy-safe review funnel for solo trades and local service businesses that guides happy customers to public review sites and gives unhappy customers a private way to share feedback — helping protect your reputation and improve local SEO.

This plugin creates a clean, mobile-friendly review funnel page that:

  • Guides satisfied customers to public review sites (Google, Facebook, Yelp, etc.)

  • Provides a private feedback form for customers who had a less-than-great experience (sent directly to your email)

  • Tracks funnel activity in WordPress (views, positive clicks, private feedback submissions)

ReviewMojo is designed to follow Google’s review policies by giving every customer an equal choice. There is no review gating, no filtering, and no discouraging negative reviews — just a clear, transparent flow that leads customers to public reviews or private feedback.

Why ReviewMojo works

Most customers won’t leave a review unless you guide them. ReviewMojo provides a simple, policy-safe flow that helps happy customers follow through — and gives frustrated customers a private outlet before they post publicly. It’s transparent, lightweight, and optimized for local businesses who rely on reputation for new jobs.

Key Features

  • Thumbs-up / thumbs-down review funnel
  • Up to four review site buttons (Google, Facebook, Yelp, or custom links)
  • Optional private feedback form (emails you directly)
  • Built-in analytics dashboard (30-day views, clicks, feedback activity)
  • Simple Setup: copy your review link and you’re done
  • “Powered by ReviewMojo” badge toggle
  • No tracking scripts, no external dependencies, no personal data stored
  • Works on any WordPress site and any theme

Perfect for:
Plumbers, HVAC pros, electricians, landscapers, home repair pros, cleaners, and any local service business that depends on reputation and word-of-mouth.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate ReviewMojo.
  3. Go to ReviewMojo → Setup:
    • Add your Google review link (optional: Facebook, Yelp, or a custom platform)
    • Enter your email address for private feedback
    • Customize the funnel text (optional)
  4. Create a page and add this shortcode:

[reviewmojo_funnel]

Or click Create Reviews & Feedback Page on the Setup screen.
sections.faq:
Does this comply with Google’s review policies?

Yes. ReviewMojo provides every customer with an equal choice to leave a public review or send private feedback. It does not hide, block, or discourage reviews.

Where does private feedback go?

Feedback is emailed directly to the address you enter in Settings. No personally identifiable information is stored in the database.

Can I link to multiple review sites?

Yes. You can display up to four review platforms.

Does ReviewMojo store any personal information?

No. Feedback is sent by email only. No personal data is logged or stored.

Will this slow down my website?

No. ReviewMojo is lightweight, uses native WordPress features, and loads no external scripts.
